name: Joseph Dulin-Didonato
statement: To Whom It May Concern, For six years, I've built an extensive portfolio of large scale murals, projects, gallery pieces, and commissions consistently delivering quality work on time. This piece should offer an exciting experience while showcasing images from Czech/ Bohemian history. The design could reflect everything from wildlife and natural features collaging with traditional patterns and clothing, my idea would center on traditional Czech themes. More specifically would be a woman enjoying a moment dancing or entertaining in her traditional folk clothing from, either, the Bohemian or Mid Moravia regions. But, The piece should most importantly have a balance in composition.
